brief:
Gadi Eisenkot pledged to form a new government under his leadership without delay or new elections, Shehab Wire reported. The former Israeli military chief warned against squandering an opportunity to replace Benjamin Netanyahu's administration, signaling a national emergency government as a fallback if negotiations fail.

Eisenkot's move reflects pressure within Israeli political circles to end the current government's tenure. His ultimatum sets a timeline for coalition talks and positions an emergency cabinet as a contingency should talks collapse.

title: Eisenkot vows swift government formation, threatens emergency cabinet
